markdown_report:
**Evidence and insights.** The starting protocol offers three insights. First, macro HR@10 weights all four categories equally. Electronics-only gains therefore cannot determine selection. Second, Electronics has 10.71% negative-over-positive errors and a −0.0749 tenth-percentile margin. These support a discrimination hypothesis, without establishing its cause. Third, simulator feedback identifies overly broad associations and overlooked connector/format distinctions. Titles may expose these distinctions, but cannot establish physical compatibility or fulfilled needs.

The supplied literature offers three further insights. [HSTU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.17152) supports learned sequential interactions. Preserve that backbone while testing item representations. [AttrFormer](https://doi.org/10.1145/3690624.3709267) motivates explicit attribute interactions, while [MARS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.00702) motivates attribute-sensitive text representations. Their results do not establish that a small encoder trained from scratch will succeed here. HSTU’s [sampled-softmax configuration](https://github.com/meta-recsys/generative-recommenders/blob/main/configs/ml-1m/hstu-sampled-softmax-n128-final.gin) motivates objective experiments. Changing sampling simultaneously would obscure representation effects.

**Framework.** Organize experiments along three directions: item specificity, current-intent selection, and ranking discrimination. Their corresponding mechanisms are ordered text encoding, internal recency bias, and sampled training objectives. Missing evidence concerns whether each mechanism improves held-out ranking and user-perceived usefulness together.

**Candidate assessment.** Scores are 0–10; difficulty increases with implementation burden. Each cell gives a positive and negative reason. User/model alignment reflects hypotheses grounded in supplied diagnoses.

| Atomic idea | Originality | Potential | User alignment | Model alignment | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A: Ordered text residual | 5: targeted integration; established encoders | 7: transferable specificity; sparse supervision | 8: attributes and specificity; compatibility unverified | 7: finer discrimination; cause uncertain | 5: compact module; deployment parity |
| B: Learned positional recency bias | 3: straightforward adaptation; HSTU precedent | 6: current intent; coarse proxy | 6: recent purpose; redundancy unresolved | 5: suppresses stale evidence; errors unexplained | 3: small change; masking care |
| C: More uniform training negatives | 2: established objective; limited novelty | 6: stronger ranking signal; greater cost | 4: sharper relevance; attributes implicit | 8: targets separation; sampled margins imperfect | 4: simple loss; memory growth |

**Selected idea: A, ordered text residual.** At 0% progress, choose a compact extension rather than combining several interventions. It explicitly targets broad thematic substitutions and overlooked connector/format distinctions, while testing Electronics’ weak separation.

Preserve attribute tokens and encode their order with a small positional convolution before pooling. Fuse this representation into tied HSTU item vectors through one learned gate. Train every parameter jointly using the corrected baseline objective.

Compare the corrected baseline, pooled-text control, and ordered encoder only as budget permits; each deployed category uses one checkpoint. Retain fixed seeds, splits, four routes, ≤200 epochs and 200 batches/epoch. Select by host macro validation HR@10. Measure operational margins through `predict_score`; report text-perturbation sensitivity separately from compatibility. No new performance result is claimed.

idea.description: Add one jointly trained, order-sensitive title/description residual to the corrected HSTU item representation. Preserve the HSTU backbone and use exactly one independently trained model/checkpoint per category. The selected hypothesis addresses two supplied user failures—broad thematic substitutions and overlooked connector/format distinctions—and the measured weak positive–negative separation in Electronics.
idea.motivation: The simulator identifies specificity failures that item-ID histories may not resolve reliably. An ordered text encoder can represent local token relationships that mean pooling discards. Electronics’ 10.71% wrong-rank rate motivates measuring whether this added information improves discrimination. These observations do not establish that text is the cause, that compatibility is inferable, or that the proposed extension improves validation HR@10.
idea.implementation_notes:
Treat this as a proposed experiment, not an executed implementation or measured improvement. Extend the supplied corrected baseline rather than reconstructing an unspecified replacement. Retain DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, all four dataset routes, supplied splits, single-GPU execution, maximum 200 epochs, and exactly 200 batches per executed epoch. Save artifacts beneath the trial directory and account for every attempted training/diagnostic run within the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget.

Use only permitted titles/descriptions. Tokenize deterministically, preserving case, numbers, decimals, units, punctuation and direction words; record the exact tokenizer and vocabulary. Use a training-document vocabulary with PAD and UNK, fixed title/description truncation, and no external weights. Proposed small defaults are 32-dimensional token embeddings and separate width-3/5 convolutions over ordered title and description tokens. Apply explicit masks so padded windows never win pooling; return a zero text vector when no valid text exists. Concatenate field outputs and project to the baseline item dimension. Define joint_item(i) = item_emb(i) + sigmoid(g) * text_projection(i), with g initialized to -3 and a forced zero vector for padding. Tie this representation across input and candidate scoring. The text encoder is an internal part of the same network, not a separately fitted predictor. Local convolutions preserve some local relationships but do not guarantee long-range quantity binding or connector understanding.

Keep the corrected HSTU architecture, sampler, optimizer, loss and scoring convention otherwise fixed. If budget permits, compare baseline, a capacity-conscious pooled-text control, and the ordered encoder. Do not attribute a difference solely to order if parameter capacity also differs. Select with the unchanged host validation/checkpoint rule using macro HR@10, never diagnostic margins or Electronics alone. No ensemble, checkpoint averaging, independent transition/popularity score or other-trial checkpoint is permitted.

Preserve item_emb as the ID embedding module and distinguish its diagnostics from joint item-vector diagnostics. Keep log2feats(sequence), predict_score(features, items), the host ModelView interfaces, DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Compute margins through the actual operational scorer; leave unavailable metadata-category breakdowns unavailable. The loader remains (None, sequence, positive, negative), with B x L tensors. Values near 0.5 for the supplied mapped cosine statistic do not justify a collapse remedy.

For left-padded inference, read the maximum nonzero position index, handling empty sequences explicitly; never use nonpadding_count-1. Save learned parameters, architecture configuration, vocabulary, tokenizer specification, token tensors and masks in the single category checkpoint. Update the embedded predictor writer with the identical encoder, fusion, scoring and routing, and verify training/reloaded score parity on permitted examples. Controlled connector reversals or quantity substitutions can measure sensitivity, but are not labeled compatibility tests. Repeat the permitted simulator assessment if available; otherwise user-facing improvements remain unverified hypotheses.
idea.pseudocode:
CONFIG = preserve_corrected_baseline_configuration()
CONFIG.preprocessing_seed = 0
CONFIG.training_seed = 42
CONFIG.epochs = min(CONFIG.epochs, 200)
CONFIG.batches_per_epoch = 200
DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']

for category in FOUR_SUPPLIED_ROUTES:
    seed_training_rngs(42)
    histories, metadata = load_supplied_training_inputs(category)
    tokens, masks, tokenizer_state = encode_permitted_titles_descriptions(metadata)
    model = extend_corrected_HSTU_with_ordered_text_residual(CONFIG, tokens, masks)
    # joint_item = ID embedding + learned gated text residual
    # Use joint_item for both sequence inputs and candidate scores.
    for epoch in range(CONFIG.epochs):
        for batch_index in range(200):
            sequence, positive, negative = family_specific_sample_batch(histories)
            features = model.log2feats(sequence)
            loss = corrected_baseline_loss(features, positive, negative,
                                           scorer=model.predict_score)
            update_single_network(loss)
        apply_unchanged_host_validation_and_checkpoint_rule()
        account_for_shared_GPU_budget()
    save_one_selected_checkpoint(category, model, tokenizer_state, tokens, masks)
    run_family_compatible_diagnosis_with_measured_definitions()

write_embedded_predictor_with_identical_model_and_four_routes()
# Prediction loads exactly one checkpoint for the requested category.
features = model.log2feats(left_padded_sequence)
last_index = maximum_nonzero_position_or_explicit_empty_case(left_padded_sequence)
scores = model.predict_score(features_at(last_index), candidate_items)
verify_reload_score_parity_on_permitted_examples()
# Host evaluates unchanged macro validation HR@10; no test access.

originality.positive: Targets diagnosed attribute distinctions with an ordered text residual inside one HSTU, isolating a narrower hypothesis than the prior text-plus-curriculum proposal.
originality.negative: Convolutional text encoders, gated residual fusion and attribute-aware recommendation are established; benchmark adaptation is the principal contribution.

future_potential.positive: Provides a controlled path toward learning item specificity without pretrained weights, with later extensions to explicit local attribute relationships.
future_potential.negative: Sparse next-item supervision may learn brand shortcuts instead of useful distinctions; sampled HR@10 and perturbation sensitivity cannot establish compatibility or satisfaction.

code_difficulty.positive: A compact internal text module preserves the HSTU backbone and requires no additional inference predictor or negative-mining infrastructure.
code_difficulty.negative: Correct padding masks, tied joint representations, diagnostic adaptation, token assets and embedded-predictor parity require careful implementation.

related_work.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Trillion-Parameter Sequential Transducers for Generative Recommendations
contributions: Introduces HSTU as a sequential recommendation backbone.
Provides the family-preserving foundation for the proposed internal item-representation extension.
limitations: Does not establish that the proposed scratch-trained ordered text residual improves this four-category benchmark.
Temporal and sequential mechanisms do not directly establish product compatibility or fulfilled needs.

related_work.title: AttrFormer
contributions: The supplied search summary describes explicit categorical and numerical attribute relations for sequential recommendation.
Motivates retaining attribute distinctions rather than collapsing all text into broad similarity.
limitations: The task does not provide the generic structured ratings, prices, stores or item categories.
Its reported contribution does not validate extracting reliable compatibility information from the permitted text.

related_work.title: MARS
contributions: The supplied search summary describes multiple attribute-aware text representations and attribute-level interest matching.
Supports investigating item specificity beyond one pooled text vector.
limitations: Its pretrained language representations are outside this task’s permitted setup.
Transfer to a compact encoder trained from scratch remains an experimental hypothesis.

related_work.title: Official HSTU sampled-softmax configuration
contributions: Supplies an established HSTU example using 128 negatives, normalized embeddings and temperature 0.05.
Motivates a separate future objective ablation within the same model family.
limitations: A MovieLens configuration does not establish optimal Amazon hyperparameters.
Changing normalization, temperature or negative sampling during the selected representation experiment would confound attribution.
